snippet.title: Syncblade: Prototype - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#indiegame #rhythmgame #anime #syncblade 
We're thrilled to announce our new rhythm game "Syncblade: Prototype", where you slash through waves of Zombeat to the music you love, playing as Akemi, a unique mysterious samurai. Import your favorite songs and unleash beat-synced special attacks.

Wishlist "Syncblade: Prototype" now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4043810/Syncblade_Prototype

Join "Syncblade: Prototype" Discord server: 
https://discord.gg/7Kgm6WQwWE
